Reader in Economics, Aston Business School.
Centre Director, [Centre for Business Prosperity](https://www.aston.ac.uk/research/bss/research-centres/business-prosperity).
Former Lead Economist, [Foreign Trade Research Center (Trade+)](https://kse.ua/kse-impact/trade/), Kyiv School of Economics.
PhD in Economics, University of Maryland.

I work on how firms, industries, and countries grow by integrating into global
markets — and what happens when that integration goes into reverse. From
Brexit and the US–China trade war to Ukraine's wartime export economy, the
questions are the same: who bears the cost, which firms adapt, and — where
supply chains run through a handful of chokepoints — what makes some of them
more resilient than others when those chokepoints break.
